pushInfo.whenEnabledTheGatewaySendsAnHttpPostTo: When enabled, the gateway sends an HTTP <0>POST</0> to your URL for each selected event. The body is <1>application/json</1> with these fields:
pushInfo.textTheSmsBodyForIncomingSmsNullFor: <0>text</0> — the SMS body for <1>incoming_sms</1>; <2>null</2> for calls.
pushInfo.msisdnThisLineSOwnNumberMayBeEmpty: <0>msisdn</0> — this line's own number; may be empty until learned.
pushInfo.fromTheCallerSenderNumberEmptyIfTheCalle: <0>from</0> — the caller / sender number (empty if the caller withheld it).
pushInfo.deliveryIsBestEffortWithAn8sTimeoutA: Delivery is best-effort with an 8s timeout; a failing endpoint is logged, not retried.
pushInfo.selfSignedTlsOnTheTargetIsAcceptedCertif: Self-signed TLS on the target is accepted (certificate not verified).
pushInfo.whenEnabledTheGatewaySendsAFormattedMess: When enabled, the gateway sends a formatted message to your chat/channel via the Telegram Bot API (<0>sendMessage</0>) for each selected event. It carries the same core fields as the webhook. Example:
pushInfo.createABotWithBotfatherAndCopyTheBot: Create a bot with <0>@BotFather</0> and copy the <1>bot token</1>.
pushInfo.chatIdYourOwnNumericIdFromUserinfobotOr: <0>Chat ID</0>: your own numeric id (from <1>@userinfobot</1>), or a channel id like <2>-1001234567890</2>.
pushInfo.addTheBotToTheChannelGroupAsA: Add the bot to the channel/group as a member (and admin, for channels) so it can post.
pushInfo.sendTheBotAMessageFirstIfPushingTo: Send the bot a message first if pushing to a private chat, so it's allowed to reply.

settings.managerUrlForEngineEventCallbacksAutoIfB: Manager URL (for engine event callbacks; auto if blank)
settings.ifTheVowifiTunnelOrImsRegistrationDropsW: If the VoWiFi tunnel or IMS registration drops while the SIM is still present, the line auto-retries. After the retry budget is exhausted it stops and shows the failure reason. With network auto-recover enabled, a network/DNS freeze will re-provision the line once connectivity returns (SIM-auth and other permanent faults still stay stopped).
settings.howLongAnOutgoingCallRingsBeforeTheGatew: How long an outgoing call rings before the gateway gives up and cancels it. Most carriers roll an unanswered call to voicemail by ~30s. A shorter value also reduces how many times the callee is re-alerted when they don't answer. Applies to new calls after the line is re-provisioned/restarted.
settings.howOftenTheGatewayProactivelyRekeysTheIp: How often the gateway proactively rekeys the IPsec (ESP) security association with the carrier's ePDG. IKEv2 does not put a lifetime on the wire, so this is a local policy: the SA is refreshed (seamless make-before-break) before it silently ages out and the carrier stops accepting traffic. <0>0 disables</0> proactive rekey (the SA is only refreshed if the carrier initiates it). Applies after the line is re-provisioned/restarted.
settings.postAJsonBodyToYourUrlWhenAn: POST a JSON body to your URL when an incoming SMS or call arrives. Click <0>ⓘ Format</0> for the exact payload.
settings.sendIncomingSmsCallsToATelegramChatOr: Send incoming SMS/calls to a Telegram chat or channel via a bot. Click <0>ⓘ Format</0> for setup and the message layout.

sim.idrIsHowTheApnIsPresentedToThe: IDr is how the APN is presented to the ePDG. <0>Bare APN</0> (just the APN string) is what most carriers' ePDGs expect and is the safe default; <1>APN-FQDN</1> (<2>{{apnExample}}</2>) is required only by a few stricter carriers — some networks reject it.
sim.imsAddressFamilyMustMatchTheCarrierSIms: <0>IMS address family</0> must match the carrier's IMS PDN. <1>Auto-detect</1> figures it out for you (matches known carriers, else probes families after SIM auth) and pins the one that works — leave this unless you know the carrier needs a specific family. Telus/EE are IPv6; Vodafone UK is IPv4.
sim.onByDefaultAfterASuccessfulAttachTheCarr: On by default. After a successful attach the carrier's AAA may hand out a short-lived re-authentication identity; presenting it on a reconnect lets the network skip a full SIM auth run. If it has expired the engine notices the rejection and retries with the permanent IMSI identity by itself, so this is safe to leave on. Turn it <0>off</0> for a carrier whose AAA rejects it on every reconnect (O2 UK) to skip that wasted attach attempt.

reasons.no_card: No SIM card detected in the reader.
reasons.pin_blocked: SIM PIN is blocked — PUK required.
reasons.epdg_unresolved: Can't resolve the carrier's VoWiFi (ePDG) address — the carrier may not support Wi-Fi Calling, or check DNS / internet connectivity.
reasons.tunnel_network: Can't establish the VoWiFi tunnel — network problem (no response from the carrier's ePDG).
reasons.tunnel_sim_auth: Can't establish the VoWiFi tunnel — SIM authentication (EAP-AKA) was rejected by the carrier.
reasons.tunnel_not_authorized: Can't establish the VoWiFi tunnel — the carrier's ePDG refused the identity before checking the SIM. The line is likely not provisioned for Wi-Fi Calling, or the ePDG blocks connections from this network/region.
reasons.tunnel_proposal: Can't establish the VoWiFi tunnel — the carrier rejected the encryption settings (IKE proposal).
reasons.registering: VoWiFi tunnel is up — registering to the carrier's IMS…
reasons.reg_rejected: Can't register to the carrier's IMS (authentication or provisioning issue).
reasons.ok: Working — connected to the carrier over Wi-Fi.

sms.quickHelp: Changes only the exact blacklist rule for this SIM. Global rules, prefixes and whitelist entries remain in effect. Blocking adds the selected type; unblocking removes only that type.
sms.historyHelp: Body-free incoming SMS decisions. Monitor delivers normally; Enforce suppresses matching messages. Outgoing SMS are unaffected.
sms.modeHelp: Disabled: no SMS filtering. Monitor: evaluate and deliver. Enforce: suppress personal blacklist matches unless whitelisted. ARCEP and Saracroche do not apply to SMS. Requires the updated Engine; legacy Engines continue delivery.
sms.globalDisabled: Global SMS mode is inherited only when this SIM has no explicit SMS mode. Call mode is independent.
